cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The restricted runner rejected the Unix socket required by the server-owned authority fixture before the real-renderer RED assertions could execute.
impact: The same RED probe must be rerun on a socket-capable host.
lesson: Record restricted-host socket failures separately and rerun authority probes on a supported host.

cause: The real legal ARMA-GARCH workflow still passed the family builder's raw report mapping into the owner-issued document seam, so ReportDocumentWriterV1 rejected the payload before template and file IO.
impact: The legal owner/projection ARMA path reports model success but fails to produce the real HTML report and indexed file hash.
lesson: Build the ARMA report through one owner-issued document payload before invoking the real template writer.

cause: The typed ARMA document bridge now constructs the owner-bound document from the deterministic builder and the real workflow renders it through ReportDocumentWriterV1 and the template writer.
impact: The legal path produces indexed HTML with matching rendered file hash while missing admission remains typed unavailable and raw-builder-free.
lesson: Keep the family builder behind one owner-issued document adapter and test the real template/writer boundary.

cause: The standalone ARMA deliverables test intentionally passes the raw family mapping to the post-remediation typed render_html_report contract.
impact: This legacy ownerless/raw caller remains outside the legal ReportStage owner-issued path and is not widened in remediation-8.
lesson: Keep standalone raw deliverable callers documented as legacy gaps rather than weakening the typed renderer boundary.

cause: The normal-run traceable-output E2E invokes the orchestrator without a server-owned Report capability and still asserts an ownerless report.html file.
impact: The ownerless assertion remains outside the legal ReportStage admission contract and is not widened in remediation-8.
lesson: Keep ownerless normal-run HTML assertions documented until their fixture injects server-owned Report admission.

cause: The advanced-statistics normal-run E2E invokes the orchestrator without a server-owned Report capability and still reads an ownerless report.html file.
impact: The ownerless assertion remains outside the legal ReportStage admission contract and is not widened in remediation-8.
lesson: Keep ownerless normal-run HTML assertions documented until their fixture injects server-owned Report admission.

cause: The isolated ARMA pack declaration test hits the pre-existing loader-to-orchestrator statistical_tests circular import before the declaration assertion; the remediation-8 diff does not touch that import chain.
impact: The independent pack bootstrap assertion remains NOT VERIFIED in this line and is outside the scoped report remediation.
lesson: Keep unrelated import-order failures separate from evidence/report remediation and do not widen scope to repair them.

cause: The ARMA public workflow runtime test invokes an ownerless normal run and still asserts report.html; this is the same fail-closed ownerless normal-run boundary already recorded as the required legacy GAP, not a fourth independent contract.
impact: The existing ownerless normal-run GAP remains documented without widening the ReportStage contract or adding another formal GAP identity.
lesson: Group equivalent ownerless normal-run assertions under the existing documented GAP identity.

cause: A prior overlap review event used the digest of the orchestrator E2E file while its evidence ref named the ARMA pack runtime file; the append-only event was not edited and this correction records the exact runtime-file digest.
impact: The formal record now contains an explicit correction anchor without mutating its append-only event history.
lesson: Compute evidence digests from the exact referenced file before appending a formal event.

cause: The pre-existing pack bootstrap error event named the ARMA pack runtime file but initially carried the orchestrator E2E digest; the append-only history is preserved and this event supplies the exact runtime-file digest.
impact: The formal evidence set contains a verified digest anchor for the out-of-scope bootstrap error.
lesson: Bind every formal evidence digest to the exact path named by its evidence reference.
